questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized policy addressing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction and climate change mitigation?
questions.configuration: Approved Corporate Climate / Decarbonization Policy document signed by Board or C-level executive.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company measure, calculate, and report Scope 1 (direct) greenhouse gas emissions in line with the GHG Protocol?
questions.configuration: Annual GHG inventory report, fuel consumption logs, emission calculation sheets, or third-party carbon audit.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company measure, calculate, and report Scope 2 (indirect - purchased electricity/heat/steam) greenhouse gas emissions?
questions.configuration: Electricity utility bills, CEA grid emission factor calculation sheet, or verified carbon disclosure.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company calculate and report Specific GHG Emission Intensity relative to production output or revenue?
questions.configuration: GHG intensity metric verification report showing numerator (tCO2e) divided by production volume (MT or units) or revenue (INR/USD).

questions.assessment_question: For applicable carbon-intensive sectors (steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, hydrogen), does your company track embedded emissions in compliance with EU CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism)?
questions.configuration: CBAM quarterly communication sheet or embedded direct and indirect specific emissions calculation per CN code.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized Energy Management Policy with explicit goals for energy efficiency and renewable energy adoption?
questions.configuration: Corporate Energy Policy document approved by executive management.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company systematically monitor and track energy consumption broken down by source (Grid Electricity, Diesel, Natural Gas, Coal, Biomass, Solar)?
questions.configuration: Monthly/annual utility bills, meter logs, fuel delivery challans, and centralized energy register.

questions.assessment_question: What is your company's Specific Energy Consumption (SEC) / Energy Intensity per unit of production or revenue?
questions.configuration: Annual energy audit report or internal MIS showing total energy (GJ) divided by production (MT/units) or revenue (INR/USD).

questions.assessment_question: What percentage of your company's total electrical or thermal energy consumption is sourced from renewable energy (on-site solar/wind, off-site PPA, green tariffs, biomass)?
questions.configuration: Solar generation generation meter logs, Green Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) bills, or Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

questions.assessment_question: Has your company implemented major energy efficiency measures (e.g. Variable Frequency Drives - VFDs, Waste Heat Recovery, LED retrofits, high-efficiency IE3/IE4 motors)?
questions.configuration: Technical project completion report or CAPEX documentation of implemented energy efficiency retrofits.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized Water Stewardship Policy that includes water conservation, recycling, and responsible effluent discharge?
questions.configuration: Water Management Policy document approved by management.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company monitor, meter, and report total water withdrawal and water consumption broken down by source (Groundwater, Municipal, Surface, Tanker)?
questions.configuration: Water meter logbooks, water bills, Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) / State Authority abstraction permits.

questions.assessment_question: What is your company's Specific Water Consumption per unit of production (kL / MT or unit of finished product)?
questions.configuration: Water audit report, Environmental Statement (Form V), or production-linked water accounting sheet.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company operate an on-site Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) / Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) that meets all Pollution Control Board discharge standards?
questions.configuration: Latest quarterly/monthly effluent analysis test reports from a NABL-accredited / MoEFCC-recognized laboratory, showing compliance with PCB limits.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized policy for waste management, hazardous chemical handling, and circular economy / resource efficiency?
questions.configuration: Approved Waste & Chemical Management Policy document.

questions.assessment_question: Are all hazardous wastes disposed of exclusively through Authorized TSDF (Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility) operators or authorized recyclers approved by the Pollution Control Board?
questions.configuration: Copies of valid TSDF membership agreements and signed Form 10 manifests for all hazardous waste dispatches.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a structured waste reduction, reuse, and recycling program aiming for Zero Waste to Landfill (ZWL)?
questions.configuration: Zero Waste to Landfill validation certificate or comprehensive waste hierarchy implementation report.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company monitor, test, and report stack air emissions for Particulate Matter (PM), Nitrogen Oxides (NOx), and Sulfur Dioxide (SOx)?
questions.configuration: Latest quarterly stack emission monitoring reports from a NABL-accredited / MoEFCC-approved environmental laboratory.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company possess a valid Consent to Operate (CTO) / Consolidated Consent & Authorization (CCA) issued by the relevant State Pollution Control Board?
questions.configuration: Copy of the latest valid CTO / CCA certificate showing validity dates, approved manufacturing capacities, and consent conditions.

questions.assessment_question: Does your manufacturing facility hold a valid Factory License issued by the Chief Inspector of Factories under the Factories Act?
questions.configuration: Valid Factory License copy showing renewal endorsement and authorized horsepower/workforce limits.

questions.assessment_question: Has your organization obtained external certification under ISO 14001 (Environmental Management System)?
questions.configuration: Valid ISO 14001 certificate issued by an accredited certification body with IAF/NABCB accreditation mark.

questions.assessment_question: Has your company received any environmental fines, show-cause notices, legal directions, closure notices, or prosecutions from environmental regulators in the last 3 financial years?
questions.configuration: Self-declaration of zero notices OR copy of regulatory notices received, penalty payment receipts, and formal closure letters from the regulator.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) Policy covering permanent employees, contract workers, and on-site sub-contractors?
questions.configuration: Approved Corporate EHS / OHS Policy signed by the Managing Director / Board and displayed at prominent factory locations in local languages.

questions.assessment_question: Has your facility achieved external certification under ISO 45001 or OHSAS 18001 (Occupational Health & Safety Management System)?
questions.configuration: Valid ISO 45001:2018 certificate copy issued by an accredited certification body.

questions.assessment_question: What was your company's Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) per million man-hours worked during the last financial year (for employees and contract workers)?
questions.configuration: Annual safety performance register, accident investigation logs, or statutory Form 24 / ESI injury reports.

questions.assessment_question: Were there any workplace fatalities (including permanent employees, contract workers, and third-party personnel) during the last 3 financial years?
questions.configuration: Statutory accident records submitted to Factory Inspectorate / ESI, or certified declaration of Zero Fatalities.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company provide appropriate, certified Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to all workers free of charge and strictly enforce its mandatory use on the shop floor?
questions.configuration: PPE issue registers signed by workers, PPE procurement invoices, and shopfloor PPE compliance monitoring records.

questions.assessment_question: Does your facility have a valid Fire Safety License / Fire NOC issued by the Fire Services Department and maintained automated fire protection systems?
questions.configuration: Current Fire NOC / License copy, fire hydrant and extinguisher inspection cards, and maintenance contracts.

questions.assessment_question: Is there a formal Joint Management-Worker Safety Committee constituted with equal representation from workers and management that meets at least quarterly?
questions.configuration: Safety committee constitution order, minutes of quarterly meetings, and action-taken reports.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company conduct annual occupational health checkups and pre-employment medical examinations for all workers exposed to hazardous processes?
questions.configuration: Certificates of Fitness issued by the Factory Certifying Surgeon (Form 32 / Form 33) and annual occupational health summary reports.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company strictly comply with Statutory Minimum Wage regulations across all employee categories, contract workers, and third-party personnel?
questions.configuration: Latest monthly wage registers, bank disbursement confirmation statements, and statutory minimum wage schedule notifications.

questions.assessment_question: Has your company evaluated its compensation structures against Living Wage benchmarks (e.g. Fair Wage Network / Anker Methodology) and committed to closing any living wage gap?
questions.configuration: Living wage assessment benchmark report, Fair Wage Network accreditation, or wage structure analysis comparing entry-level wages with regional living wage figures.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company enforce statutory working hour limits (maximum 48 hours per standard work week) with at least one mandatory rest day in every 7-day period?
questions.configuration: Electronic biometric attendance punch logs, shift rosters, and statutory Form 11 / working hour registers.

questions.assessment_question: Are all employees and workers issued formal written employment contracts detailing terms of employment, job responsibilities, wages, working hours, leave entitlements, and termination notice periods?
questions.configuration: Sample executed appointment letters / employment agreements for permanent and contract workforce.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company ensure full statutory social security enrollment and timely remittances (Provident Fund - PF, ESIC / Workplace Insurance, Gratuity) for all regular and contract workers?
questions.configuration: Monthly PF Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) with payment receipts, ESIC monthly contribution challans, and Gratuity policy trust statement.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company maintain strict policies and operational procedures prohibiting all forms of forced, bonded, indentured, or involuntary prison labor?
questions.configuration: Forced Labor Prevention Policy and operational verification audit reports across labor contracting agencies.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formal policy recognizing workers' fundamental rights to freedom of association, to form or join trade unions, and to bargain collectively without fear of discrimination or retaliation?
questions.configuration: Approved Freedom of Association Policy document, employee handbook clause, or trade union recognition agreement.

questions.assessment_question: What is the gender composition of your overall workforce (percentage of female employees and contract workers)?
questions.configuration: Annual headcount report broken down by gender across permanent and contract staff.

questions.assessment_question: Has your company constituted an Internal Committee (IC) under the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) at Workplace Act with an external independent member?
questions.configuration: Official office order constituting the Internal Committee (IC) with names, designations, and external NGO/legal expert credentials.

questions.assessment_question: Has your company filed its Annual POSH Compliance Report with the designated District Officer as mandated under Section 21 of the POSH Act?
questions.configuration: Stamped acknowledgement copy of the POSH Annual Return submitted to the District Collector / Women & Child Welfare Officer.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company track and report the average number of training hours completed per employee/worker per year (disaggregated by gender and employee category)?
questions.configuration: Annual training records report, LMS completion logs, or training attendance sheets.

questions.assessment_question: If eligible under Section 135 of the Companies Act, has your company spent at least 2% of its average net profits on CSR projects during each of the last 3 financial years?
questions.configuration: Audited Annual Report CSR annexure showing mandated expenditure vs actual expenditure for the last 3 financial years, and MCA Form CSR-2 filing.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formal governance structure (e.g. Board Committee, Sustainability Steering Committee) responsible for overseeing ESG and climate performance?
questions.configuration: Board Charter, Terms of Reference (ToR) of Sustainability / CSR Committee, or organizational governance structure document.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company publish an annual public Sustainability Report, Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR), or Integrated Report prepared in accordance with recognized international frameworks (GRI, SASB, ISSB)?
questions.configuration: Web link or PDF copy of the latest published Sustainability / BRSR / Integrated Report.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized Anti-Corruption and Anti-Bribery Policy covering facilitation payments, kickbacks, and improper business inducements?
questions.configuration: Approved Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption Policy document signed by the Board / Executive Leadership.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formal Conflict of Interest Policy requiring annual written conflict declarations from all directors, executives, and procurement personnel?
questions.configuration: Conflict of Interest Policy document and sample completed annual Conflict of Interest disclosure declarations.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company deliver mandatory anti-corruption and business ethics training to 100% of employees, directors, and critical business partners?
questions.configuration: Training completion records, employee ethics LMS logs, or training attendance sheets.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formal Fair Competition and Ethical Trade Policy prohibiting anti-competitive agreements, price-fixing, market allocation, and abuse of dominant position?
questions.configuration: Fair Competition / Antitrust Policy document approved by executive management.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formal Whistleblower Protection / Vigil Mechanism Policy providing safe, accessible reporting channels for employees, contract workers, and suppliers?
questions.configuration: Approved Whistleblower / Vigil Mechanism Policy document published on company website or intranet.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company maintain an independent, secure, and anonymous whistleblower hotline or reporting portal operated 24/7 (via third-party provider or dedicated ombudsperson)?
questions.configuration: Contract agreement with independent hotline provider, screenshot of reporting portal, or dedicated toll-free helpline number documentation.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a formalized Information Security and Data Privacy Policy aligned with applicable regulations (such as Digital Personal Data Protection - DPDP Act 2023, GDPR, or ISO 27001)?
questions.configuration: Approved Information Security & Data Privacy Policy document signed by CISO / Executive Leadership.

questions.assessment_question: Has your organization achieved external certification under ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management System) or SOC 2 Type II compliance?
questions.configuration: Valid ISO/IEC 27001 certificate copy or SOC 2 Type II independent auditor's report.

questions.assessment_question: Have there been any instances of non-compliance with applicable statutory laws, or receipt of show-cause notices, license suspensions, or material legal penalties in the last 3 financial years?
questions.configuration: Statutory Auditors' report annexures (CARO 2020), legal compliance certificates, or certified declaration of Zero Material Penalties.

questions.assessment_question: Does your company have a comprehensive Supplier Code of Conduct formally covering ethics, anti-corruption, human rights, labor laws, and environmental standards?
questions.configuration: Approved Supplier Code of Conduct document published and communicated to all active vendors.

questions.assessment_question: What percentage of your company's targeted or active suppliers (by procurement spend) have formally signed or acknowledged the Supplier Code of Conduct?
questions.configuration: Vendor onboarding compliance report, signed Code of Conduct acknowledgement repository, or ERP procurement tracker.
